title: GLM-5.2-NVFP4 on B200, vLLM v0.31: TP=8 and DEP=8 (8 GPUs) and 1P1D disaggregated (16 GPUs); no-router vs llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified vs llm-d-router v1.0.0 turn-priority, with and without 820 GiB CPU offload
description: Step 25. One vLLM pod (8 B200, MTP 3, GPU KV 1.57M tokens), AgentX replay of the Weka Claude Code trace, 60 min per point. CPU tier 820 GiB = 18.17M tokens (MLA: one copy shared by the 8 GPUs, 48,408 B per token). no-router c=1 to 16 and llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified lease 30 s c=12, 16 ran on a fresh vLLM pod per point (max-num-seqs 2x concurrency); all other points reset the KV cache on a running pod (max-num-seqs 64). Shared points: no-router c=1 and 4 took < 1% of prompt tokens from the CPU tier, so they also appear in the no-offload arm. From c=48 the llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified runs collapse after the 1800 s forced admissions at minute 30 to 35. Capacity variants: the gate admits 2x or 4x the GPU pool (capacityTokens with vLLM cache info disabled). Step 27, DEP=8 (attention data parallel 8, MoE expert parallel 8, TP=1 per rank): GPU KV 818,175 tokens per rank (6.55M in total), CPU tier 102.5 GiB per rank (18.17M tokens in total), max-model-len 783,872, max-num-seqs 32 per rank, KV cache reset per point. no-router: one API server, vLLM's internal DP load balancer. Session affinity and llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified: one EPP endpoint per rank (ports 8000 to 8007); session affinity uses session-affinity-scorer on x-session-id. Session affinity c=32 is a later run (dep8-affinity-r2), c=64 the second try (dep8-affinity-retry). DEP=8 llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified c=96 and 128: experiment C (run-dep8-highc.sh), on servers c and b, client memory limit 64 GiB. Step 28, llm-d-router v1.0.0 turn-priority (image ghcr.io/llm-d/llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:v1.0.0): flow control with program-aware-fairness strategy turn-priority (default weight 0.05 per second, inactivity 120 s), default utilization detector, defaultRequestTTL 0 (no shedding), one EPP per TP=8 server, KV cache reset per point (max-num-seqs 64). c=24 started 85 min after the other three (client CPU).  Step 29 adds llm-d-router v1.0.0 turn-priority on top of session affinity on DEP=8 (4 points). Step 35 adds 1P1D prefill/decode disaggregation across two nodes (5 points, c=16 to 64): one prefill and one decode TP=8 server, KV over cross-node NIXL/RDMA, 820 GiB CPU tier on each (2 x 18.17M tokens), vllm-project/vllm#62862 fix, vLLM's NIXL toy proxy (every request P then D). Per-GPU metrics divide by 16 GPUs; compare at equal concurrency per GPU (1P1D c=N against TP=8 c=N/2). Step 36 adds llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified on the 1P1D pair (4 points, c=24 to 64): EPP from zetxqx/llm-d-router#15, capacity = the prefill server's GPU KV pool (1,572,864), lease 10 s, always-disagg through the llm-d disagg sidecar.

router.config:
# Variant thunder-gpu-l10: thunder-plugins.yaml with only the idle lease changed,
# 30 s -> 10 s (about the p84 of per-session gaps between turns at c=16). The
# capacity is still the GPU pool, read from vLLM's cache_config_info.
#
# thunder-agent gate as in PR3 (llm-d/llm-d-router#3076, image
# llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:thunder-agent-pr3-a025437b-produces, PR3 plus the
# Produces() fix). Same pipeline as
# deploy/config/thunderagent-config.yaml in that branch, with capacityTokens set
# to this pool's real KV size (the fallback when cache_config_info is absent).
# Step 25: 1667712 = 26058 GPU blocks x 64, the smallest pool seen across the
# B200 restarts (1667712 to 1694080 tokens).
# Endpoints come from a file (file-discovery: no Kubernetes API, so no RBAC,
# which our account cannot create on a4-pr). The file lists the vLLM Service
# ClusterIP, stable across the per-point restarts of the single vLLM pod.
# Timeouts: the 1800 s backstop needs defaultRequestTTL 0 (no queue eviction),
# envoy ext_proc message_timeout above 1800 s (2400 s in the lane values), and a
# client that waits longer than that. PR3's own default backstop is 30 s, below
# the 60 s default TTL; if you use it, drop defaultRequestTTL and say so.
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
featureGates:
- flowControl
plugins:
- name: vllm-endpoints
  type: file-discovery
  parameters:
    path: /config/endpoints.yaml
    watchFile: true
- type: agent-identity
  parameters:
    additionalSessionHeaders:
    - x-session-id
- type: thunder-agent
  name: thunder
  parameters:
    capacityTokens: 1667712
    utilThreshold: 1.0
    idleLeaseSeconds: 10
    headWaitStarvationMs: 1800000
    evictionTtlSeconds: 3600
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
flowControl:
  defaultRequestTTL: "0s"
  saturationDetector:
    pluginRef: thunder
  defaultPriorityBand:
    fairnessPolicyRef: thunder
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: thunder
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
dataLayer:
  discovery:
    endpoints:
      pluginRef: vllm-endpoints
